note: The two sets are nearly identical in content: both capture the finished floor elevation 2'–9 1/2" above grade 0'–0", the room contents of the Centre Module and Living Room Section, and the 3/8"=1'-0" scales for sections A1 and C1. Both make the same clear error of stating the Living Room finished floor height as 2'–3 1/2", which the page (text and image) shows as 2'–9 1/2". Both also repeat the finished floor and grade level elevations two to three times and include the same vague 'building section contains room' claims and trivial WEST MODULE location claim. The only differences are cosmetic entity naming (B adds the A1/C1 identifiers), so neither set is meaningfully better.
remarks: Both sets misread the Living Room finished floor height as 2'–3 1/2"; the page shows 2'–9 1/2" for both sections (identical elevations). Both duplicate the finished floor and grade level elevations under multiple entity names (Centre Module / Finished Floor / FINISHED FLOOR), and both include low-value claims ('WEST MODULE | location | West', 'building section | contains room'). The 'CENTRE MODULE | location | K' claim is weakly supported by the leader line and grid bubble and is borderline. Neither set notes that the two section drawings share the same finished floor and grade level datums.
